judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking, moody sky photo dominated by an impressive layered lenticular cloud over snowy mountains.
strengths: Strong contrast between dark cloud mass, blue sky, and snowy peaks
Bird silhouette adds scale and a focal point
weaknesses: Foreground sea is very dark and visually empty
Main cloud mass is somewhat underexposed, losing shadow detail
